evidence.title: socket.io disconnect on Lambda freeze
evidence.content: WebSocket connection dropped after ~30s: Lambda execution environment frozen between invocations; no persistent process to hold the socket.

evidence.title: Postgres LIKE '%term%' full-scan latency
evidence.content: ILIKE '%query%' on 120k rows: p95 = 2.4s (seq scan, no trigram index that helped for infix search). Atlas Search prototype p95 = 40ms.

evidence.title: PDFKitPro LICENSE.txt
evidence.content: Commercial redistribution prohibited without per-seat license.

evidence.title: Ticket-summary accuracy by model
evidence.content: Cheapest model: 61% factual accuracy on 50 labelled tickets (target 85%). Reviewers rejected summaries as unreliable.

attempts.goal: Live updates for the Orbit task board so teammates see changes in real time.
attempts.approach: Add a socket.io WebSocket server running on the serverless (Lambda) backend.

blockers.detail: Serverless functions freeze between invocations and cannot hold a long-lived WebSocket connection; sockets drop after ~30s.

conditions.text: The realtime service runs on a persistent (non-serverless) runtime such as a container or App Runner.

attempts.alternative: Server-Sent Events (SSE) for one-way live updates.

attempts.goal: Fast full-text search across tasks and comments.
attempts.approach: Use Postgres LIKE / ILIKE '%term%' queries for infix substring search.

blockers.detail: Infix LIKE '%term%' cannot use a normal index and does a sequential scan; p95 hit 2.4s on 120k rows.

attempts.goal: Export a task report as a nicely formatted PDF.
attempts.approach: Integrate the PDFKitPro library for PDF generation.

blockers.detail: PDFKitPro forbids commercial redistribution without a paid per-seat license; incompatible with our shipping model.

conditions.text: A budget is approved for a commercial per-seat PDF license, or an MIT/Apache alternative is adopted.

attempts.alternative: Evaluate an open-source (MIT) PDF library or server-side HTML-to-PDF.

attempts.goal: Auto-summarize support tickets to speed up triage.
attempts.approach: Use the cheapest available LLM to generate ticket summaries.

blockers.detail: Cheapest model reached only 61% factual accuracy (target 85%); reviewers rejected the summaries as unreliable.

conditions.text: A cheap model benchmarks at or above 85% accuracy on the labelled ticket set.

attempts.alternative: Route summaries to a stronger model, or fine-tune a mid-tier model.

decisions.title: Use server-side sessions for authentication
decisions.rationale: Simplest to ship first; store session in the DB and set a cookie.

decisions.title: Switch authentication to stateless JWTs
decisions.rationale: Wanted stateless auth to scale horizontally without shared session store.

decisions.title: Adopt Better Auth (sessions) as the current auth system
decisions.rationale: JWT revocation and refresh were error-prone; Better Auth gives managed sessions with revocation out of the box.

decisions.title: Use Server-Sent Events for live task-board updates
decisions.rationale: After WebSockets failed on serverless, SSE gives one-way live updates that work over plain HTTP.

decisions.title: Move the realtime service to AWS App Runner
decisions.rationale: We need a persistent runtime for realtime; App Runner keeps a long-lived container process instead of freezing between invocations.

prompts.classify: Classify the message as one of: decision, attempt_start, attempt_result, intent, question, noise.
prompts.extract: Extract a structured attempt or decision with goal, approach, outcome, typed blockers, evidence, conditions, hours, and the alternative chosen.
prompts.judge: Decide whether the new intent is the SAME approach under the SAME conditions as the candidate dead end. Return match, confidence, reason, and whether the blocker still applies.
prompts.answer: Answer the project question with citations to attempt and decision ids. Never present a superseded decision as current.
prompts.reflection: Propose exactly one harness setting change from failed evals and negative feedback.
